name: io.github.dahshanlabs/klypix-mcp
title: KLYPIX Project Brain
description: Active state management for multi-agent coding: a shared, versioned project brain over MCP.

packageArguments.name: --vault
packageArguments.description: Folder holding your .klypix canvases. Omit it and the server serves the project root you pass to brain_sync.

environmentVariables.name: KLYPIX_VAULT
environmentVariables.description: Alternative to --vault: absolute path to the folder holding your .klypix canvases. The --vault argument takes precedence.
